d:
Guru Paduka Stotram is a powerful chant that enables one to become receptive to the Guru's Grace. Written by Sri Adi Shankara, the chant extols the virtues of surrendering to the Guru, by which one can attain to the ultimate.
Lyrics and translation:
Anantha samsaara samudhra thaara
naukaayithaabhyaam guru bhakthidhaabhyaam
vairaagya saamraajyadha poojanaabhyaam
namo namah shri guru paadhukaabhyaam
In this endless ocean of cyclical creation…
Devotion for the Guru - the boat that can sail across,
